name: Celeborn
subtitle: Lord of the Galadhrim
game_text: At the start of each skirmish involving Celeborn, you may reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is an <culture>Elven</culture> card, you may discard it to wound each minion in that skirmish.
flavor_text: “...with him went the last living memory of the Elder Days in Middle-earth.”
